claim_scope: one-record train-only phase-carrier capacity comparison; not model promotion
hypothesis: Multiplying WFP envelope outputs by a deployment-legal exact uniform-medium travel phase exp(-i*omega*tau) will let the model memorize the fixed sigma-2 background record materially better than the same WFP trained as a raw complex-field predictor.
single_conceptual_change: analytic travel phase carrier enabled versus disabled

shared.architecture: E1 WFP width32 rank16 depth4 radii1,2,3,4
shared.frequency_schedule: all 64 bins exactly once per 16 updates in shuffled order
shared.loss: full-record energy-normalized physical coefficient error plus 0.05 CPML coefficient error
shared.travel: exact Euclidean source distance divided by registered uniform background velocity
shared.cpml: same carrier continued into the 20-layer left/right/bottom exterior domain

failure_signal: If either phase seed remains >=0.95 or phase mean does not beat raw mean, close direct phase-carrier background prediction and do not rerun the 256-record E1.
rollback: Additive diagnostic only. Preserve all old checkpoints and E1 caches. Keep one best checkpoint per E1c lane and do not launch 256-record training on rejection.
